description: Add a person to a project with a role — the admin Project screen's "Invite Users". The email is resolved to an existing user; when nobody has it the user is INVITED (created and the invitation email sent) unless `invite:false`. Existing members are preserved — the project's member list is merged, never replaced — and the membership is read back to confirm. Defaults to the connected project and to the project's QA role.

email.description: Email address of the person to add, e.g. someone@yopmail.com.

invite.description: Invite the user when the email is unknown (default true). false = fail instead.

name.description: Display name — used only when the user has to be invited.

projectId.description: Project id. Defaults to the connected project.

roleId.description: Role id inside that project. Default 1 (the QA role).

name: project_user_add
title: Add or invite a user to a project (SimplifyQA)
